title: Design principles / identity collage
slide_intent: Show the range of a visual language so viewers can recognize relationships among unlike ingredients.
strategic_value: A common palette and geometric vocabulary can connect DB photography, typography and graphics.
demonstration: A cropped modular collage combines railway photographs, logo, bold text, sleeper motif, pictograms and illustrative graphics.
practical_value: Compare the ingredients as a family before applying them individually.

content_islands.name: Modular collage
content_islands.spec: Arrange light and dark cells containing the mark, type, rail photographs and graphic specimens.

reference_purposes.Expression: The header assembles the brand’s contrasting visual ingredients into one grid.
